title: China has more hotpot restaurants than McDonald's worldwide | China Travel Expert
description:
You think McDonald's is everywhere? China has more hotpot restaurants than McDonald's has stores on the entire planet.

McDonald's finished 2025 with about 45,356 restaurants worldwide. China, meanwhile, had an estimated ~500,000 hotpot outlets in 2024–2025 (it peaked near 535,500 in late 2024). That's more than ten times McDonald's global count — just for one style of eating. Hotpot here isn't a dish, it's a social ritual: a shared simmering pot, raw meat and vegetables, everyone cooking at the table.

🧭 Expert Tip: For your first hotpot, order a half-and-half (鸳鸯) pot — spicy mala on one side, mild broth on the other — so you can taste the heat without committing to it.

麦当劳全球约 4.5 万家，中国火锅店约 50 万家——同一种吃法，门店数是麦当劳十倍多。
